title: Rainy day advice
text: On rainy days, outdoor crops generally do not need manual watering, so the player can spend energy on mining, fishing, social visits, gathering resources, or organizing inventory.

title: Late night safety
text: If it is late at night, the agent should warn the player to return home soon instead of suggesting long trips or risky tasks.

title: Low energy safety
text: If stamina is low, the agent should suggest low-cost tasks, eating food if available, or stopping work. It should not recommend energy-heavy tool use.

title: Inventory management
text: If inventory is full or nearly full, the agent should suggest storing, selling with caution, or organizing items before collecting more resources.
